_comment: A reference DVB-I service with every service-level field populated, delivered over DASH.
Loaded by the Templates control next to '+ Add Service'.
Loading a template does not save anything. It opens the service editor pre-filled, so this is
a starting point and a way to see what each field looks like when set. Nothing reaches the
published list until Save Service, then Save & Publish.
One field is deliberately left empty: customEpgUrl overrides the list-level content guide for
this service, so pointing it at a URL that does not serve TV-Anytime removes the guide instead
of enriching it, and the right value is deployment-specific.
subtitleLanguage has no control in the editor UI but is honoured when generating the list: it
fills tva:SubtitleLanguage, and falls back to the service's first language, then the list
name: Reference service (all fields, DASH)
